card: Adds detailed debug and trace logging for compact block reconstruction, recording transaction counts and total byte sizes sourced from prefills, the mempool, the extrapool, and peer requests. It separates extrapool accounting from mempool counts and logs all missing transaction IDs at trace level without the previous under-five-transaction limit. This improves visibility into compact block reconstruction performance and was split out to support prefill work in PR 35558.
evidence: PR description: 'Split from #35558, this makes it easier to observe compact block reconstruction performance by: At debuglevel=trace logging all missing TX's in a CMPCTBLOCK... Logging the sizes and counts of tx's used from the prefill, mempool, and extrapool... Logging the sizes and sources of redundant transactions'

Commit 83e2cc4fce: 'It doesn't make that much sense to log here only when there's a few transactions, since either a user is interested in what tx'es caused reconstruction to fail or they aren't, so log all txid's and this a trace-level log message.'

Commit 41e7b93723: 'Previously, in the log message and in the `InitData()` logic, the mempool was treated as a superset that includes the extra pool, it makes more sense to treat them as separate pools.'
problem: Compact block reconstruction logging lacked detailed metrics on transaction sizes and prefill redundancies, and lumped extrapool transactions into the mempool count. It was also difficult to inspect which transactions caused reconstruction roundtrips when more than four transactions were missing because the missing txid log was suppressed.
scope_notes: Internal logging and accounting adjustments in `src/blockencodings.cpp` and `src/net_processing.cpp`; separates reconstruction accounting of available transactions from logging counters.
summary: Improves diagnostic logging during compact block (`CMPCTBLOCK`) reconstruction and responses to `GETBLOCKTXN`. It logs counts and byte sizes of transactions sourced from prefills, the mempool, the extra transaction pool, and missing-transaction fetches, and tracks redundant prefilled transactions. In addition, it logs all missing transaction IDs at the trace debug level instead of limiting output to cases with fewer than five missing transactions, and decouples mempool and extra-pool counts in `PartiallyDownloadedBlock`.
